title: Parallax plates
description: Photographic plates move through a continuous rail while bounded image crops shift within fully covered frames.
useCase: Browse an editorial photo collection with depth provided by the photography and its relative motion.
interaction: Drag or swipe the rail; use Previous, Next or keyboard arrows to center an image.
reducedMotion: Dragging remains direct; navigation and release settle immediately without inertia. Host pause cancels the active animation and disables controls.
limitations: Five local photographs; no video playback or data fetching. Crops use 130% image width with a bounded 13% frame-width shift. Photographs retain separate Unsplash terms.
look: Off-white page with a horizontal rail of varied-size photographs (surf, white concrete architecture, red running track), a small spaced-caps header and a monospace counter.
motion: Dragging throws a wrapping rail with decaying inertia, then a 380 ms cubic ease-out centres the nearest plate; each photo shifts inside its frame against the motion.
adapt: `render` positions each plate from `offset` via `wrap` and sets the image parallax (`-x * 0.065`, clamped to 13% of width); `coast` handles inertia decay and `settle` the 380 ms snap. Replace `PLATES` with your images and sizes.
